_README: PSX broker/research conviction watchlist. Any listed name present in the TradingView Pakistan scan is force-included into the PSX candidate set with its analyst block + TCE/IM3 scoring, even if it sits outside the auto-screen's market-cap band. This only SCREENS the names (surfaces them for your own analysis + the IM3 strength read) — it does NOT buy, rank, or recommend them. Mega-caps OGDC/PPL/MCB/FFC/HUBC are already force-included; banks auto-admit to the System-B model — neither needs listing here. Edit freely. Accepts a bare list or this {"psx_watchlist":[...]} form; only 'psx_watchlist' (or 'tickers') is read.
_source: Seeded from Standard Capital (SCS) Pakistan Market Valuation Matrix, dated 16-Apr-2026 (scstrade.com REP-033). Rule: name appears in >=2 of SCS's quality/income screens (High ROE, High ROA, High EBITDA Margin, High Dividend Yield), liquid, excluding the 5 mega-caps + banks. These are factor-screen outputs, NOT broker buy calls or recommendations — verify against your AKD/Topline note and refresh as the matrix updates. Replace with your own conviction names anytime.
